selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection exposed a transaction-integrity defect in ChangesetStore.apply: each path was checked immediately before mutating that path, so a conflict on a later file could occur after earlier files had already been changed. That violates the intended all-or-none preimage gate for a staged multi-file changeset and can leave the workspace partially mutated while the changeset remains STAGED.

decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. The committed DWAC North Star and four-mode router source contracts were replayed against fresh canonical code evidence; one narrow, central, evidence-rich transaction defect dominates this cycle.

code_reality: core/changesets.mjs checked and mutated files in one sequential loop.
A later APPLY_CONFLICT could therefore happen only after earlier paths were already written or deleted.
tests/changesets.test.mjs covered a single-file preimage conflict but did not prove that a later-file conflict leaves all earlier files untouched.
The existing staged preimage snapshots, WorkspaceService stat/write/remove operations, and rollback model are reused; no new transaction architecture is introduced.
changes: ChangesetStore.apply now preflights every staged path against its captured preimage before performing the first mutation.
Only after all preflight checks pass does the existing mutation loop run.
A regression test changes the second file after staging and proves that APPLY_CONFLICT leaves the first file untouched and the changeset STAGED.

verification.evidence: The new later-file conflict test observed a.txt changed to new-a before b.txt raised APPLY_CONFLICT.

truth_boundaries: This closes the deterministic later-preimage-conflict partial-apply defect; it does not claim filesystem-level crash atomicity across arbitrary I/O failures.
Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED and was not declared solved by this transaction-layer repair.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive external action was performed.
